description.zh: 大脑能同时抓住的东西很有限：工作记忆一次只维持几个单元，把项目分组能腾出空间；注意像带宽有限的通道，干扰越多越难找到目标；记忆痕迹随时间变弱，新旧内容还会互相干扰，而一个好的提取线索能把它拉回来。
description.en: The mind can hold only a little at once: working memory keeps a handful of units in play, and grouping items frees up room; attention is a channel of limited bandwidth, so more distractors make targets harder to find; memory traces fade with time and old and new material interfere, while a good retrieval cue can bring them back.

aliases.zh: 前摄干扰 后摄干扰

label.zh: 目标是信号，干扰物是噪声
label.en: Targets are signal, distractors are noise

reason.zh: 在干扰中找目标，可以按信号检测论来读：干扰物越多，信号和噪声越难分开，命中率下降、虚报上升——把“看不清”与“不敢说有”分开，要用 d′ 和判据 c。
reason.en: Finding targets among distractors can be read with signal detection theory: more distractors make signal and noise harder to separate, so hits fall and false alarms rise — telling “cannot see it” apart from “unwilling to say yes” takes d′ and the criterion c.
